---
title: "Obesity & Snacking ANCOVA"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(ggplot2)

fat <- read_xlsx("data/Obesity.xlsx", sheet=1)
names(fat)[names(fat) == "CAEC"] <- "SNACKS"
fat$SNACKS <- factor(
  fat$SNACKS,
  levels=c("0","1","2","3"),
  labels=c("No snacking","Sometimes","Frequently","Always")
)
```

## Descriptive statistics
```{r}
summary_by_snacks <- fat %>%
  group_by(SNACKS) %>%
  summarize(
    n=n(),
    mean_weight=mean(WEIGHT, na.rm=TRUE),
    sd_weight=sd(WEIGHT, na.rm=TRUE),
    .groups="drop"
  )
summary_by_snacks
```

## ANCOVA
```{r}
ancova_model <- aov(WEIGHT ~ SNACKS + AGE, data=fat)
summary(ancova_model)
```

## Adjusted means
```{r}
adjusted_means <- emmeans(ancova_model, ~ SNACKS)
summary(adjusted_means)
```

## Planned contrast: no snacking vs average of other groups
```{r}
contrast_result <- contrast(
  adjusted_means,
  method=list("No vs Others"=c(1, -1/3, -1/3, -1/3))
)
summary(contrast_result, adjust="none")
```

## Visualization
```{r}
ggplot(fat, aes(x=AGE, y=WEIGHT, color=SNACKS)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=TRUE) +
  labs(
    title="Weight, Age, and Snacking Behavior",
    x="Age", y="Weight", color="Snacking Behavior"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Interpretation
The omnibus ANCOVA and a planned contrast answer different questions. A significant overall factor effect does not require every pairwise or planned comparison to be significant.
